function: Excluded for system: over-the-air federated learning with Bayesian MMSE aggregation over a scalar block-fading MAC, single antenna at users and server, no RIS (p. 4, eq. 6; p. 11).
notes: Reasons 1 to 5 do not apply: research article; the learned element is the federated model (linear and logistic regression, CNN on MNIST, pp. 9-11); the function is over-the-air aggregation, which would be area 7. Reason 6 applies: the uplink is y = sum of h_i x_i + w with one scalar fading coefficient per user (p. 4: "experiences at round r a block fading channel"), there is no antenna array or RIS, and the conclusion leaves antennas to future work (p. 11: "Future work could explore the impact of multi-antenna systems"). Title and DOI 10.1109/TSP.2024.3351469 on p. 1 match the work.
